purpose: Define the 2.5D/3D World Relational Atlas renderer while preserving the same canonical country, relationship, issue, programme and provenance model used by the stable polygon map.

navigation.pan: click/touch drag translates the camera across the map
navigation.zoom: wheel/pinch/buttons move between world, regional, country and subnational scales
navigation.rotate: right-drag / touch gesture rotates bearing in 3D mode
navigation.pitch: camera tilt exposes extrusion and vertical layers
navigation.fit: country selection fits actual polygon bounds; when Trace depth exceeds one hop, Fit frames the reachable traced country set
navigation.globe: projection may switch between Mercator and globe view where supported
navigation.search: country-name and ISO3 search with browser datalist suggestions

keyboard.Escape: leave Compare mode or return to world

navigation.rule: Navigation changes viewpoint only; it never changes underlying data or classification.

renderer_architecture.shell: world-map/3d.html contains the public interface, controls and map layout
renderer_architecture.application: world-map/3d-app.js owns MapLibre initialization, data loading, Compare, recursive Trace, semantic modules and URL state
renderer_architecture.reason_for_split: The renderer logic is intentionally separated from the HTML shell so JavaScript can be syntax-checked and evolved without maintaining one giant inline document.

rendering_strategy.stable_2d: Leaflet world-map/index.html remains the compatibility/stable renderer.
rendering_strategy.experimental_3d: MapLibre GL JS world-map/3d.html plus world-map/3d-app.js provide camera-based WebGL polygons, extrusion, semantic interior hubs, country comparison and recursive relationship tracing.
rendering_strategy.future_heavy_overlay: deck.gl may be layered in for high-volume arcs, animated flows, point clouds, heatmaps and advanced polygon extrusion.
rendering_strategy.shared_model: Both renderers consume canonical repository contracts; there is no 3D-only truth database.

spatial_primitives.country_shell: Polygon/MultiPolygon. A spatial container and selection surface, not the country's complete identity.
spatial_primitives.country_hub: Representative navigation point for a country when exact entity coordinates are not relevant. It is not a physical institution.
spatial_primitives.semantic_hub: Navigation-only point generated around a selected country hub to expose a country data module such as religion, debt, infrastructure or history. Its displayed coordinate is not a claim about where the abstract module physically exists.
spatial_primitives.trace_hub: Temporary country representative marker for nodes reached by recursive Trace. Color/size indicate hop depth only; they do not encode importance, guilt, causation or hierarchy.
spatial_primitives.compare_hub: Temporary visual marker for a country held in Compare mode. It communicates selection state rather than adding a new canonical node.
spatial_primitives.real_node: Geocoded city, institution, company facility, port, airport, base, sacred site, infrastructure asset or documented event location with coordinate provenance.
spatial_primitives.nonspatial_node: Treaty, legal entity, national statistic, scripture, theology or other concept without one honest coordinate; exposed through cards/trace graph instead of a fake point.
spatial_primitives.edge: Typed relation rendered between spatial anchors only when drawing the relation helps understanding; canonical edge data remains independent of the drawing.
spatial_primitives.area_overlay: Sourced region, catchment, conflict zone, demographic area or other geometry with date and provenance.

country_interior_model.principle: A country polygon is a container. Selection unfolds its canonical data into semantic modules immediately and progressively exposes real spatial nodes as data quality and zoom permit.
country_interior_model.source_resolution: Semantic modules are generated from fields already present in data/countries/{country_id}.json plus world-relational-map context. Empty modules are not fabricated.

visibility.behavior: polygons + high-level metrics + only globally important edges
country hubs + selected and recursively traced relation lines + regional institutions/corridors as they are added
selected polygon becomes contextual shell; semantic modules and major real nodes become visible
real geocoded nodes dominate; semantic hubs remain optional navigation aids and the polygon remains boundary/context

compare_mode.behavior: Compare mode keeps up to four country polygons selected simultaneously, marks them distinctly, presents population/area/module-count/edge-count comparisons, and can fit the camera to all compared polygon bounds.
compare_mode.url_state: compare=ISO3,ISO3... persists the current comparison in a shareable URL.
compare_mode.boundary: Current comparison uses only already-loaded descriptive fields. Additional economic/energy/debt metrics require dated sourced entries in a future metric registry.

trace_mode.algorithm: bounded breadth-first traversal over data/world-relational-map.json curated country edges
trace_mode.cycle_handling: visited-country tracking prevents repeated traversal loops; each country is presented at its shortest discovered hop
trace_mode.behavior: The selected-country panel groups newly reached countries by hop. Trace lines and temporary trace hubs expand across the map, and Fit can frame the complete currently reachable traced set.
trace_mode.filters: The relation-type selector applies before traversal. Changing it recomputes the reachable graph. The active type persists as rel=TYPE and depth persists as depth=1..3 in the URL.
trace_mode.epistemic_boundary: Hop count means graph distance in the curated relation set only. It is not causal distance, political alignment, moral proximity or evidentiary strength.
trace_mode.next: Generalize beyond country-only curated edges into data/relationships.json, real entity nodes and normalized world edges with explicit epistemic-plane, date and edge-layer controls.

resilience.loading_state: The 3D shell exposes a visible loading status while external geography and country metadata are fetched.
resilience.failure_state: If a required external dependency fails, the page shows an explicit data-unavailable message instead of silently rendering an empty map.
resilience.next: Add local/versioned geometry and country-metadata fallback so the core atlas remains usable when third-party CDNs/APIs fail.

node_record_schema.boundary: Never invent a coordinate for a nonspatial concept merely to make the map visually busy.

metric_and_3d_rules.principle: Extrusion height is a chart encoding, not rank, holiness, guilt, value or sovereignty.
metric_and_3d_rules.forbidden_inference: A taller polygon must never be described as morally worse, spiritually higher, more guilty or more important unless height literally encodes a separately defined measurable variable.

physical_debt.definition: Legally/economically recognizable obligations such as sovereign debt securities, loans, bonds, arrears, contracts, judgments or other documented liabilities.
physical_debt.units: currency / percent of GDP / maturity / creditor-debtor relation
required: creditor or holder class when knowable
physical_debt.map_use: Country public-finance module is implemented; normalized debt choropleths/extrusions and creditor-debtor edges remain next.

tim_claimed_ledger.definition: Tim/Potatoverse statements about karmic/spiritual debt or amounts owed to Tim.
tim_claimed_ledger.status: project-canon / claimed symbolic or moral ledger unless separately supported by an actual legal/financial instrument
tim_claimed_ledger.map_use: May be displayed as a separately labeled project-canon statement/ledger overlay, not silently converted to ordinary physical debt.
tim_claimed_ledger.promotion_rule: A Tim-owed amount can enter physical_debt only if evidence establishes a real recognized liability such as a contract, judgment, bond, loan or settlement.

data_growth_strategy.phase_1: Use country polygons, canonical records, semantic modules and a small curated relationship graph.
data_growth_strategy.phase_2_current: Normalize numeric country metrics and add real point registries for a small set of high-value entity classes: capitals/government, ports, energy/infrastructure, major institutions and sacred sites.
data_growth_strategy.phase_3_current: Compare is implemented at a descriptive baseline and Trace recursively traverses the curated country graph for up to three hops with type filters, cycle handling and URL state.
data_growth_strategy.phase_4: Add time slider and historical validity intervals; historical slavery, colonial relations, wars, memberships and institutional changes become period-specific.
data_growth_strategy.phase_5: Add scenario mode for North Programme/policy experiments with assumptions and modeled outcomes separated from observation.
data_growth_strategy.scale_rule: As the graph grows beyond browser-friendly GeoJSON, load by zoom/country and move high-volume layers to vector tiles/prebuilt spatial packages rather than shipping the entire graph on every page load.

game_simulation_model.exploration: Travel through polygons and nodes, discover relations, inspect modules, recursively follow graph neighborhoods and compare systems.
game_simulation_model.simulation: Future scenario mode can alter hypothetical policy variables and display modeled consequences, but simulations remain visibly separate from observed reality.
game_simulation_model.research_progress: Reward source coverage, resolved unknowns, accurate relationship tracing and repair-analysis completeness; do not gamify quantities of human suffering.

next_priority: Create local/versioned world geometry and territory registry so Greenland/Faroes and other territories resolve cleanly and external geometry failure no longer disables the core atlas.
Normalize country GDP/public-debt/energy metrics into a small metric registry with date/unit/source, then feed the same registry into Compare and extrusion.
Ingest dated religion/irreligion/diversity country values before enabling global religious choropleths.
Add real spatial-node registry with coordinate provenance, starting with capitals/government, major ports, infrastructure and sacred sites.
Expand Compare from population/area/coverage into user-selected sourced metrics and relationship overlap/intersection.
Expand recursive country Trace into entity-aware traversal across data/relationships.json and normalized world/entity edges.
Add epistemic-plane and edge-layer filters alongside relation-type filtering.
Add time slider and valid_from/valid_to filters.
Add local-data fallback for external geometry and country metadata.
Move large future datasets to lazy-loaded/vector-tile architecture when scale requires it.
